Privacy Policy

This is a courtesy translation. The German version is legally binding and takes precedence in case of any discrepancy.

1. General Information

Protecting your personal data is important to us. Below we inform you which data is processed when you visit our website and for what purpose.

2. Controller

Villa Rosengarten
rosengarten.casa

Beate and Jens Petersen
Kanalstraße 16a
22085 Hamburg, Germany

Email: info@rosengarten.casa

3. Hosting

Our website is operated by an external hosting provider. In this context, personal data that is automatically collected when visiting the website is processed, in particular:

  • IP address
  • Date and time of access
  • Browser type and operating system
  • Referrer URL
  • Pages accessed

This processing is based on Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, for the technically secure provision of the website.

4. Contact

If you contact us by email or contact form, the data you provide will be stored in order to process your inquiry.

Processing is based on Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR and/or Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

5. Smoobu Booking System

We use the Smoobu booking system for online bookings.

Provider:
Smoobu GmbH
Pappelallee 78/79
10437 Berlin, Germany

When using the booking system, personal data such as name, contact details, booking data and payment information is processed.

More information: https://www.smoobu.com/de/datenschutz/

6. Embedding YouTube

Our website may embed videos from the YouTube platform.

Provider:
Google Ireland Limited
Gordon House, Barrow Street
Dublin 4, Ireland

When playing a video, personal data may be transmitted to Google.

More information: https://policies.google.com/privacy

7. Google Maps and 360° Views

This website uses Google Maps and embedded 360° views to display our location and virtual tours.

Provider: Google Ireland Limited

When calling up the maps or 360° views, personal data may be processed.

8. Google Analytics

This website uses – only with your prior consent via the cookie banner – the web analytics service Google Analytics (GA4).

Provider:
Google Ireland Limited
Gordon House, Barrow Street
Dublin 4, Ireland

Google Analytics uses cookies and similar technologies that enable an analysis of how our website is used (e.g. pages visited, time spent, device used). The information generated is transmitted to Google and processed there, including in the USA.

Processing takes place exclusively on the basis of your consent pursuant to Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, § 25(1) TTDSG. You can withdraw your consent at any time via the "Cookie settings" link in the footer; Google Analytics will then no longer be loaded on your next page visit.

More information: https://policies.google.com/privacy

9. Spam Protection via Cloudflare Turnstile

To protect our contact form from automated spam submissions, we use the "Turnstile" service by Cloudflare.

Provider:
Cloudflare, Inc.
101 Townsend St.
San Francisco, CA 94107, USA

Turnstile analyses technical characteristics in the background to distinguish automated form submissions from genuine inquiries, without requiring an image puzzle to be solved. Personal data such as the IP address may be transmitted to Cloudflare in the process.

Processing is based on our legitimate interest in a functional, spam-free contact form pursuant to Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR.

More information: https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/

10. Cookies

Our website uses cookies. Technically necessary cookies are used without separate consent (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Cookies for Google Analytics are only set if you have explicitly agreed to this in the cookie banner.

You can change or withdraw your consent at any time via the "Cookie settings" link in the footer.

11. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access pursuant to Art. 15 GDPR
  • Rectification pursuant to Art. 16 GDPR
  • Erasure pursuant to Art. 17 GDPR
  • Restriction of processing pursuant to Art. 18 GDPR
  • Data portability pursuant to Art. 20 GDPR
  • Object to processing pursuant to Art. 21 GDPR

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority.

12. SSL/TLS Encryption

For security reasons, this website uses SSL/TLS encryption.

13. Changes to this Privacy Policy

We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy so that it always complies with current legal requirements.
